sanskrit:
सहयज्ञाः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा पुरोवाच प्रजापतिः ।
अनेन प्रसविष्यध्वमेष वोऽस्त्विष्टकामधुक् ॥ ३-१०॥
iast:
sahayajñāḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā purovāca prajāpatiḥ
anena prasaviṣyadhvameṣa vo’stviṣṭakāmadhuk 3-10
translation: The PRAJAPATI (the Creator) , having in the beginning (of creation) created mankind, together with sacrifices, said, by this shall you prosper; let this be the milch-cow of your desire — KAMADHUK (the mythological cow which yields all desired objects) .
